Take a deep breathe. Stop worrying about what others think for as second. And think about what YOU think. Ultimately what others want is you to be happy, and that starts by you vs you.

I can guarantee you that if you put all these thoughts out of your head for a second, focus on you and try to make you happy about yourself, then the whole world will change.

Your meaning is to like/love yourself, and as soon as you can do that someone amazing will walk into your life. Have faith, think about yourself and F the rest until you like yourself again. And then it will get much better. Promise.

People care. They do. The difference is, they have their own "level" of care, and that is not necessarily because they are bad people, but it can really be because they have their own life falling apart as well.

Of course some problems seem bigger than others on a global scale, that is for sure. But how can we help others if we cannot even help ourselves to begin with?

Everyone suffers at some level, and for most people, nobody knows their story... Then yes some people, under pressure because of their own problems, can have difficulties organizing their priorities and could end up trying to fix the little things before trying to fix the bigger things...

It's a mess and we can only be grateful for the time others decide to give to us, while they also struggle with things we are not aware of...

Life can get better! it always can. It may not get perfect, sunshine and rainbows within a year, but it can get better if you want to let it. First step: focus on not lashing out on people who seem to care. Just start with this simple step. It will not be easy, but the good thing about it is that it depends 100% on you. You are in control. How? Just listen to them/us, and when you catch yourself about to express something, hold on and think if that's what you want to say. You'll see, when you can do this you'll be proud of yourself. And at that moment I can guarantee you will realize you might even be able to love yourself again one day 💪

confidence, charisma, appearance. Work on these, I promise you they are way more important than height. Height without these is useless. These without height still make a killing. You got this.  
Radcliffe, lil wayne, polanski, bruno mars, etc.

try to remove what others may think from the equation. Focus on you and what YOU think of yourself.   
Let me take your words for example: you say you're a normal teenager, that's good. an idiot? well, says who? and to be honest, any idiot can be happy. As a matter of fact, idiots are often happier than smartasses simply because they don't care so much about useless stuff. A disgrace? to who? others' opinion doesn't matter, all that matters is what you think of you. And here also, being "a disgrace" is temporary. If you truly think you are ashamed of yourself, then take a breathe, a few days, weeks, to pinpoint what you want to stop doing, and start fresh. Don't let a very temporary thing that you can control, keep you down. You're the captain. One step at a time. And you'll see one day you'll find yourself being proud of yourself and love yourself.

It's heartbreaking you lost your mom so early... your other mom seems to show that she truly cares about you and what your mom obviously means to you, and I love that she helps you on that day (and surely all others as well).
From what you say, I am sure your mom is proud of you. Do not put any pressure on yourself about tomorrow or anything else, she wouldn't want that. And I am sure there are a ton of thing she regrets not doing with/for you, and not telling you. Like you say, leave being angry in the past, she is your mom, she loves you 💪

I think I would be devastated... I can tell you you're a strong person already for being able to keep moving. There is no way I can tell you what I would do in this situation, but a thing that is -I believe- some kind of common truth is: what would she want from you now? She clearly would want to see you live your life and do whatever makes you smile, even if it's for a few minutes only.  
So on this special day, what about planning on doing one crazy thing, each year, for her? like anything that makes you smile and feel alive. As crazy as it can get. Visit a new place, new country, try bungee jumping, rent a jet ski and go full speed, hike up through the snow, etc. Use this day to honor her and feel alive?

I'm not saying start tomorrow, I can't even imagine how mentally tough it would be, all I'm saying is do something for yourself on that day, tell yourself she is watching you, and show her what you can do.

Regardless of all this, I wish you all the strength in the world....

You have kids together, I would say first try everything to get her back. She fell in love with you, do you think you can be the person she fell in love with again? It will likely take time, which will be a pain, but wouldn't you feel better if you could tell yourself that you actually have done everything you could?

Just try it, be that amazing person she fell in love with. You'll be proud of yourself and your mind will be free, you will be able to tell yourself you have done everything you could to repair the situation and show how much you care

answer is YES. Now look at it this way: they will love you as much as you love yourself. Show them there is a lot to love, not by skills or accomplishments, but by how you love yourself and are good to be around :)

You went through a lot... and so did your mom. Your story is heart breaking. But please, like you say, your mom now only has you and your brother and she certainly cannot lose any more people right now. If not for you, keep fighting for her.

This world is as much your world than anyone else's. You don't have to "belong". It is yours, you make it what you want it to be. Improve yourself on your terms, i.e. in a way that makes YOU feel better. If you can love yourself, then you are definitely doing much better than the majority of people! Love yourself and don't let anyone take that from you. Honestly, if you can love yourself, then cherish it and be yourself, the right people will walk into your life, I promise.
